**Finding submitted: deviation (critical).**

- **What the document does:** Article XII (¶p0128–p0129) is a pure one-way indemnity from us to SFG, covering any exercise of the licence rights, the conduct of our business, and any breach by us. No Licensor indemnity exists anywhere — confirmed by searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "infring" across the full text.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** Article XIII affirmatively states Licensor shall in no circumstance be liable for claims that use of the Licensed Technology results in IP infringement, and the warranty disclaimer excludes non-infringement. Combined with the one-way Licensee indemnity, this is the rule's walk-away scenario, not merely a fallback shortfall.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** inserted the standard Licensor defence/indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice/control/cooperation mechanics, expressly outside the Article XIII cap so it has substance; narrowed our indemnity to breach of the licence restrictions, our breach of law, and content we supply, with a carve-out for anything Licensor indemnifies.
- **Not double-flagged:** the level of the Article XIII cap (one-half of amounts paid) is left to the limitation-of-liability rule; we touched it only via the indemnity carve-out.
